author: gobernment
body:
(Note: I'm not going to kill your precious.)

Rendezvous 3.5 is probably the most successful tournament map next to Wahiz, and I assume most of you think the map is perfect the way it is. However, I wanted to make a few minor adjustments, but also, I will treat it as a normal map release and have competitive users tell me their thoughts on whether or not it should push. The only thing I am more adamant for pushing is the webs problem, since most other maps fix it (e.g scoreboxes double layering cobwebs.) Front webs would be left alone, since I don't care about the front.

New features:
- Thickened cobwebs in back part of spawn
    - Prevents blockglitching
    - Fixes it to work as intended (I never wanted jumping over it)
- Bedrock wall between the walls of spawn
    - Helps defenders
    - Balances the thicker cobwebs
- New iron supply design
- Fixed missing blocks
- Removed bridge outside of spawn
    - Nobody in competitive uses it
    - Stupid to have when there's front lines
- Added minor soulsand patches to the sides of spawn
- Added ladders to front lines
   - Easier to skybridge or fend against skybridgers
   - Convinence since everyone would just break through the roof anyway

Overview of map (nothing really changed visually)

Also, if you guys like some features but not others, feel free to tell me so I can see what would make the map better.
(I'm leaving the cake by the way)
